items.title: Plants may be evolving the wrong traits for a warming world
items.title_en: Plants may be evolving the wrong traits for a warming world
items.title_zh: 植物可能正在进化出不适合变暖世界的性状
items.summary_en: Morning glories may be getting caught in an evolutionary tug-of-war between surviving climate change and attracting increasingly scarce pollinators. Over just nine years, researchers found that the plants’ rate of adaptation plunged by 96%, even though they still had plenty of genetic diversity to evolve.
items.summary_zh: 牵牛花可能正陷入一场进化拉锯战：一方面要适应气候变化，另一方面又要吸引日益稀少的传粉者。研究人员发现，在短短九年间，尽管这些植物仍拥有丰富的遗传多样性以供进化，但其适应速率却骤降了96%。

items.title: Deep beneath Mars, scientists find a vast hidden magma system
items.title_en: Deep beneath Mars, scientists find a vast hidden magma system
items.title_zh: 在火星地表深处，科学家发现了一个庞大的隐蔽岩浆系统
items.summary_en: Deep beneath Mars, scientists have found evidence of enormous magmatic systems once thought to require Earth-like plate tectonics. Seismic measurements suggest molten rock repeatedly evolved and recycled itself through the Martian crust, potentially across hundreds or thousands of kilometers. The discovery challenges long-held ideas about how complex planetary crusts form.
items.summary_zh: 在火星地壳深处，科学家们发现了曾被认为需要类似地球的板块构造才能形成的巨大岩浆系统的证据。地震测量数据显示，熔融岩石在火星地壳中反复演化并循环，其范围可能达数百或数千公里。这一发现挑战了关于复杂行星地壳形成机制的传统观点。
